description: Seoul and Tokyo session state, kimchi premium for 8 coins, BTC and ETH funding rates, the BTC regime, US Treasury yield / dollar index / Asian FX context, upcoming and recent macro, crypto and Japan events with results, and recent US crypto regulation filings. Premium, funding and regime refresh every 30 minutes; macro, regulation and calendar layers once a day. The FX reference rate used by regime_fx is from the ECB and is available free of charge at ecb.europa.eu; we cross EUR/KRW and EUR/USD to derive USD/KRW. Every response lists units for its numbers, ISO 8601 timestamps with time zones, and per-section sources with links and freshness. Price: $0.03 USD per call. Payment: x402. Inside MCP, send Base USDC in _meta['x402/payment'] and the data is returned in this call; without payment the tool returns the payment requirements. Over HTTPS, https://asia-pulse.com/report accepts Base USDC or X Layer USD₮0. No arguments.
